# TAJ HR Services

> Government-licensed (MEA Reg. No. B-3252/DEL/PER/1000+/5/11251/2025) overseas manpower recruitment agency based in New Delhi, India. ISO 9001:2015 certified. NSDC skilling partner. Places skilled, semi-skilled and unskilled Indian candidates with employers across 23 destination countries in Europe, Canada and Central Asia.

## Company
- Name: TAJ HR Services
- Founded: Operating for over 10 years

## What We Do
TAJ HR Services connects Indian job seekers with employers in Europe and Canada. Services include trade testing and candidate screening, bulk and project hiring, European work permit processing, documentation and compliance, pre-departure training, and deployment/arrival support with 90-day replacement cover.

## Key Facts
- 10,000+ pre-screened candidates in database
- 50+ partner employer companies
- 23 destination countries served (including Germany, Poland, Romania, Ireland, UK, Netherlands, Canada, Hungary, Portugal, Czech Republic, Austria)
- 98% client satisfaction rate
- 4–12 week average deployment timeline
- Industries served: Construction, Manufacturing, Hospitality, Healthcare, Logistics, IT & Technology
